Whether you are an individual relocating to Hanoi or a multinational corporation seeking housing for your employees, new office branch, industrial sites, Hanoi Home is your one-stop solution for all rental needs. Our mission is to provide 5 star rental property services including both residential and commercial leasing for foreigners in Northern provinces, supporting 5,000 customers in the period of 2025-2030. Our value is to bring value to customers. Our customers not only find their dream rental property but also gain peace of mind knowing they are backed by a reputable company dedicated to protecting their rights and offering thoughtful, accurate advices to ensure the best rental experiences. The Founder of Hanoi Home is Ms. Nguyen Thu Hang. She had been working in Business Development for 15 years. She has very good skills to work in B2B and has been managing to establish long-term relationships with dozens of Organizations and Enterprises. Hanoi Home is now a dedicated agent for many well-known and reputable organizations including International Schools, Financial Institutions, Non-Profit Organizations under her leadership. With more than 10 years of operations, our accumulated expertise helps to ease your housing search process, turns this into a seamless and enjoyable experience. Hanoi Home not only find you the best property; we also support you with related documents to submit your work permit, visa extension, or online temporary residence registration. If you need to search for your kids’ schools, nannies, live-in maid, or a cook, we will recommend the good and reliable ones suitable to your needs. Hanoi Home’s sustainable development is largely based on a devoted team who are not only proficient in housing but also excellent at customer services. Especially, Hanoi Home team are always eager to investigate the best rental based on our deep knowledge and wide sources of housing. Based on your provided information, your expected future home has been shaped in our mind. Contact with us today to experience the best housing service!
